reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-sized sachets with 2 capsules each, because I already count capsules into a zip bag before every trip and this skips that. The QR batch report is what makes me willing to try a brand with no reviews, but I would buy one box only and see.
objection: Zero reviews. I reorder the same bottle, so I won't commit until I know it sits well in my stomach and the QR report really shows the batch numbers.
would_change_my_mind: A few dozen verified reviews, or a sample/smaller trial size, would make me reorder rather than just try once.
